description: Get the trust state for a single installed pkg. Returns one of: auto_trusted (built-in com.ikenga.* shipped with the shell), auto_granted (no sensitive permissions declared), granted (user approved a specific manifest version), or needs_approval (sensitive perms declared but no current grant; either never approved, perms changed since last grant, or explicitly revoked). When state is needs_approval, MCP tools/call against this pkg returns the structured `trust_required` error until the user grants approval via Settings → Pkgs.
name: iyke_pkg_trust_status
